profile_text.body:
Khosla Ventures is a for-profit venture capital firm founded in 2004 and headquartered in Menlo Park, California. The company describes itself as investing in companies positioned to harness AI's exponential advances to build beneficial, human-aligned intelligence. It focuses on leveraging proprietary data and world-class AI talent to build category-defining platforms, including a broad finance workflow platform.

The firm maintains a notable presence in California, where it faces legal exposure across 220 cases. The company's leadership engages publicly on AI's broader economic implications, including positions on autonomous driving deployment in closed systems and the need to rethink capitalism and equity in light of AI's transformative effects on labor and capital returns in the economy.
